description: RELEASE GATE. Spike @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.0.0 vs @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0 against BOTH real clients. Capture protocol transcripts; automated conformance tests: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, malformed input, cancellation, EOF, stdout purity. title: MCP SDK v2-vs-v1 gate against real Claude Code + Codex
